intent: Compress ICTC visual beauty into semantic runtime authorities so that the same meaning has the same visual grammar without a late screenshot or beauty resolver.

minimumLattice.definition: One semantic role maps to one current presentation authority and a bounded token vocabulary.
Visual emphasis follows epistemic and decision meaning; evidence, proposals, ratings and internal approvals never visually imply stronger claims.
Records, states, actions, controls and disclosures reuse canonical semantic primitives.
The shared grammar specializes by surface archetype and viewport without changing semantic order.

global: All 13 canonical surfaces resolve to exactly one of five visual archetype families.
No canonical surface id aliases exist between blueprint, grammar and local-owner registries.
The screenshot-specific P3A stylesheet is not mounted at runtime.
P4 readability and geometry obligations survive in current semantic owners.
State is encoded as text plus style and GRC status pills enter the canonical StateChip primitive.
No new beauty-specific stylesheet is introduced.
Existing semantic/runtime CI gates remain green where executable locally.
epistemic: Evidence does not visually become a verdict.
Internal approval does not visually become independent certification.
A risk rating does not visually become objective probability.
Observed does not visually become applicable; proposed does not visually become decided; completed does not visually become verified.
AI assistance does not visually become a human decision.
external: Representative human pleasantness remains an external E3-HUMAN gate.
Fresh browser rendering is required when a browser without sandbox URLBlocklist is available.
Green local CI is not deployment assurance, accessibility effectiveness, legal compliance or enterprise readiness.

claimBoundary: P5 is a runtime semantic-design authority-compression PR candidate rebased and adversarially falsified against the recorded new-main observation. Mutation closure is deterministic source/contract model evidence, not one million users or browser sessions. Exact-head CI is the integration authority; human rendered pleasantness and deployment assurance remain external.
